sections.text: You have one letter left to deliver before the cloud post office closes. Its address reads: The Person Who Watches the Rain.

consequence.text: A gust knocks you against the rail.

sections.text: The sorter recognizes the handwriting. The recipient may be in the rain gallery, or on the roof measuring the weather.

options.description: Try the stair to the roof

sections.text: The stair sways above the city. A warm doorway leads back inside, while a final ladder reaches the roof.

options.description: Warm up inside and return to the desk

consequence.text: A cup of cloud tea warms you.

sections.text: A weather watcher waits beside a brass telescope. Below, the last mail balloon is preparing to depart.

options.description: Hand the letter to the watcher
Return the letter on the mail balloon

sections.text: The watcher reads the letter and smiles. For the first time all week, a small patch of blue opens above the city.
The mail balloon carries the letter back to its sender. You leave a careful note explaining where the watcher can be found.
